title: fix(ui): object-form drawer and modal saves toast the record-named save message
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzC6RxMfB59EsgAoNN
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao4bEiUw69ndedqMFX4DU3cu)_

Fixes #27453

Clause-②: yes (widening: @object-ui/i18n gains the public export recordSaveMessage; no accept set moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`object-form` 块以抽屉或弹窗打开（`formType: 'drawer' | 'modal'`，含 React 页面里 `formType="drawer"` 的 `ObjectForm`）保存成功后，现在弹出点名记录的成功提示，如 `Task "Fix login" updated`，与控制台记录对话框一致；提示文案改由 `@object-ui/i18n` 新导出的 `recordSaveMessage` 统一生成，控制台的两份手抄副本一并换成它。
- 为什么改：showcase 的任务台页面在抽屉里改任务、在弹窗里建任务，写入成功却没有任何反馈，违反「每次落地的写都要有点名记录的反馈」；React 页面的作用域里拿不到 toast，页面自己补不上，所以按分诊在平台补。
- 风险与回滚：只在块的抽屉/弹窗容器里加提示；控制台自己挂的 `ModalForm`、动作弹窗、设计器表单都不经过这个容器，不会双重提示（有用例钉住）；带 `submitHandler` 的表单不提示；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectFormContainer.tsx` 的 `useContainerSaveFeedback`、`ui/packages/i18n/src/recordSaveMessage.ts`、`AppContent.tsx` 里改为调用共享构造器的 `recordSaveMessage`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/containerSaveToastNamesRecord-27453.test.tsx`，预期 13 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The triage ruling (6523407987) asked for the console's named-save feedback to become reachable from the platform: the drawer and modal forms raise the same save feedback the record pages do, through one exported helper rather than a second copy of `recordSaveMessage`, with no change to the showcase page.

- **`@object-ui/i18n`** adds `recordSaveMessage(t, { label, objectDef, saved, mode })`: the record-named message (`form.createdNamed` / `form.updatedNamed`), or the object-label one (`form.createSuccess` / `form.updateSuccess`) when the ADR-0079 resolver finds nothing nameable (its `Record #ID` floor). It lives in `@object-ui/i18n` because its four keys live in that package's packs, it already depends on `@object-ui/core` (where `getRecordDisplayName` lives), and both `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/app-shell` already depend on it. No new dependency edge.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**: the console's record dialog (`AppContent`'s `recordSaveMessage`) and the record form page (`RecordFormPage`'s `handleSuccess`) each carried their own copy of that logic; both now call the shared builder. Same keys, same floor, same wording; the #27999 warning claim and `toastRecordSave` are untouched.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form`**: `ObjectFormContainer`, the container the `object-form` block supplies for `formType: 'drawer' | 'modal'` (ADR-0050 Decision 4), now wraps the author's `onSuccess`: when the container itself wrote (it has a data source and no `submitHandler`, in `create` or `edit` mode) it toasts the record-named message, then runs the author's `onSuccess`. A declared `successMessage` is used as written. The object definition is read through `getObjectSchema`, which the adapter has already cached for the form body. `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` themselves are unchanged, so a host that mounts them directly (the console's record dialog, `useActionModal`, the designer's object and field forms) keeps owning its feedback and is never toasted twice.

`examples/app-showcase` is unchanged: its task-desk page's `afterWrite` keeps closing the overlay and reloading, and the toast now comes from the platform. No `packages/spec` edit.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/containerSaveToastNamesRecord-27453.test.tsx` (new, 13 cases, each of the first six run for `drawer` and `modal`): edit toasts `Task "Fix login" updated` before the author's `onSuccess`, which still gets the record; create toasts `Task "Write release notes" created`; a metadata-only block with no `onSuccess` is toasted; a record with nothing nameable keeps `Task created successfully`; a declared `successMessage` is the toast; a `submitHandler` form is not toasted; a directly mounted `DrawerForm` with an `onSuccess` is not toasted.
- Existing suites that pin the console wording now run through the shared builder unchanged: `AppContent.recordSaveToastNamesRecord-26172`, `AppContent.recordSaveOneToast-27999` and every `RecordFormPage.*` suite (14 files, 84 tests, all green).

**Ablation.** With `ObjectFormContainer`'s `toast.success(message)` replaced by a no-op through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0 on disk), the new suite went 10 red / 3 green: every "toasts" row red, the three "not toasted" rows green, as predicted before the run. Restored by the tool: blob equal to `HEAD`'s, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Where the toast is raised, and why not inside `DrawerForm` / `ModalForm`.** The ruling allowed either the form variants or a React-page toast hook; a hook would have needed the showcase page to call it, which the ruling rules out. Inside `DrawerForm` / `ModalForm` the toast would have fired for every host that mounts them directly and toasts itself (the console's record dialog through `crud_success`, `useActionModal`), so each would have needed an opt-out. `ObjectFormContainer` is the one place where the `object-form` block is the caller (ADR-0050 Decision 4), so the feedback sits there and the direct hosts are untouched; the last test row pins that.
- **Advisory write warnings on this path are not folded into the toast.** The console's dialog and record page claim their write's answer warnings and carry them on the save toast (#27999, `claimAnswerWarnings` in `@object-ui/app-shell`). The block container lives in `@object-ui/plugin-form`, below app-shell, and has no claim, so a warning from a drawer/modal save still arrives on the write-warning channel's own toast, as it did before this change. Noted, not filed.
- **`successMessage` on a drawer/modal block was never shown before.** It is now the toast when declared; previously neither container read it.
- **Showcase unchanged** (`examples/app-showcase`): its `afterWrite` keeps closing the overlay and bumping the reload counter. Live reproduction against the showcase backend was not run in this container; the behaviour is pinned through the same `ObjectFormContainer` route the React page's `ObjectForm` block takes.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so the changeset bumps only `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/plugin-form`; the app-shell edit is a refactor onto the shared builder with no wording change.
- **Double-toast survey (e8e2bcbd).** Hosts that mount `ModalForm` / `DrawerForm` directly and own their feedback: `AppContent` (record dialog, via `crud_success`), `useActionModal`, the designer's `FieldDesigner` and `ObjectManager`. None of them passes through `ObjectFormContainer`, so none gets a second toast; the last test row pins a direct `DrawerForm` mount. Pages that use the block's container and gain a toast: the showcase task-desk page (drawer edit, modal create) and the showcase renewals page (`ObjectForm formType="drawer"`). Neither raised a toast of its own before, so neither is doubled.

## Verification

Head `e8e2bcbd` (the branch merged with `origin/main` `c48cd2c1`; the four incoming commits touch no file under `ui/`).

- New suite: 13/13 green. Ablation as described above: 10 red / 3 green, restored to `HEAD`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/ packages/i18n/`: 306 files. The first run had 2 failures in `residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx`, which pins `AppContent`'s fallback spelling `t('common.record', { defaultValue: 'Record' })`; the spelling is restored in `AppContent` and that file plus `AppContent.recordSaveToastNamesRecord-26172` re-ran 52/52 green.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` on `AppContent.recordSaveToastNamesRecord-26172`, `AppContent.recordSaveOneToast-27999` and `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage*`: 14 files, 84 tests, green.
- `type-check` (with a real `.d.ts` build of the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure): `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/app-shell` exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the six touched source files: 0 errors. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
- Derived gates on `e8e2bcbd`, every line run with stdin from /dev/null, exit codes on disk, reconciled with `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
